meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 它会复制 Telegram 适配器及其配对、Markdown 清洗辅助文件和测试,注册到频道入口,装好固定版本的适配器,并引导你创建机器人、用 4 位数字配对码完成绑定,让 Claude 通过 Telegram 收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 接入 Telegram 频道时触发;它会先复制并注册适配器,再让你在 @BotFather 建机器人、粘贴 token,最后从目标聊天发送 4 位配对码。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 频道加到 NanoClaw 里。
say.note: 会复制并注册 Telegram 适配器。

say.text: 配对码一直没成功,是不是服务没在跑?
say.note: 会检查适配器是否在轮询。

say.text: 机器人收不到群里的消息,怎么关掉 Group Privacy?
say.note: 会给出 BotFather 里的设置步骤。

howto.what_en: It copies the Telegram adapter, its pairing and markdown helpers and tests, registers it, installs a pinned @chat-adapter/telegram, and guides the BotFather bot setup plus 4-digit pairing so Claude can chat over Telegram.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to add the Telegram channel to NanoClaw; it copies and registers the adapter, then you create a bot in @BotFather, paste the token, and send a 4-digit pairing code.

say_en.text: Add the Telegram channel to NanoClaw for me.
say_en.note: Copies and registers the Telegram adapter.

say_en.text: Pairing never completes - is the service actually running?
say_en.note: Checks whether the adapter is polling.

say_en.text: The bot ignores group messages. How do I turn off Group Privacy?
